about: The USAMO, the final round of the MAA's American Mathematics Competitions (six proof problems over two days, grades up to 12); papers and solutions come from Evan Chen's notes because MAA does not post free official PDFs.

years.note: no public official MAA PDF; both files are Evan Chen's (unofficial) notes, which reproduce the six problems and give solutions
